ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels isolated to <3% of the total area, primarily at the distal tips and specific mid-lobe points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters (barnacle colonies) are located at the extreme right distal tip and extreme left distal tip. Singular white pixels are scattered in the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute angle and significant vertical depth dividing the symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; the trailing edge consists of continuous, sharp jagged peaks and valleys from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the center, tapering into narrow, acute distal tips with a slight upward sweep on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant cluster of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups located on the right distal tip, and a smaller, less dense cluster on the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (sessile cirripedes) on the distal tips of both fluke lobes; numerous irregular, jagged notches along the trailing edge edge suggest historical mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip contains a unique, high-contrast three-dimensional cluster of barnacles that creates a secondary texture profile against the water background.
